# Reviewed under AGENTS.md
import argparse


def transform(text, upper=False, reverse=False):
    if upper:
        text = text.upper()
    if reverse:
        text = text[::-1]
    return text


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Apply transform() to TEXT.')
    parser.add_argument('--upper', action='store_true', help='uppercase the text')
    parser.add_argument('--reverse', action='store_true', help='reverse the text')
    parser.add_argument('text', metavar='TEXT', nargs='+', help='text to transform')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(transform(' '.join(args.text), upper=args.upper, reverse=args.reverse))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
